Commentary.Commentary: Phew! What a start to the series we have had! Australia had this game in the bag but choked in the death overs to give England a 1-0 lead. They need to improve their performance in the upcoming games. The hosts, on the other hand, will be relieved but they need to more dominant in their upcoming games. The second T20I is on Sunday, 6th September, 2020 and it will start at 1415 local (1315 GMT). Join us for that. Until then, cheers and take care.

Dawid Malan, the MAN OF THE MATCH, says that his confidence is very high and is pleased to contribute for the side. Adds that he has surprised himself with his performance in T20s and says that he always pushes himself to perform well. Adds that competition drives him on and the England squad is one of the strongest and it is really hard to get into the side. Says that 170-180 was a good score but they ended up 15 runs short. Is happy that they ended up on the winning side.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says that it is not possible to win the game in the first ten overs and praises Warner and Finch for their batting, and their bowling did well to take wickets towards the end and it is hard to play under the lights. Adds that they always will go with a side that they think will help them win the game. Praises Tom Curran for his performance and also Jordan for the same. Adds that their lower middle order did not play well, himself included and that they will show faith with their lower order batters.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that he knew that England would keep coming hard and they struggled to find the boundaries in the last 12 balls or so. Adds that the players will learn as they move forward. States that they have plenty to work hard on. Adds that Richardson has done a good job at the death. States there are plenty of positives to take forward. Goes onto say that England are a very good side.

Earlier in the day, Australia won the toss and decided to field first. Bairstow did not perform here at all going back for just 8 runs. Jos Buttler started off with a bang hitting balls all over the park on his way to 44 but he was sent back to the hut by Pat Cummins. Dawid Malan played really well, and along with Buttler and Jordan, was the only English batter to cross the double figure mark. For the Australians, Richardson, Agar and Maxwell were the stand-out performers as they all picked up 2 wickets each. There are two more T20Is remaining in the series so Australia will have a chance at redemption in two days time. Stick with us as we bring you the presentation ceremony!

What a match this has been! It had gone right down to the wire and the last ball had to be bowled to decide the outcome of this fixture!  It looked like Australia would win this one easily but England did really well to crawl back into this game towards the last 10 overs of the Australian batting. England picked up their first wicket in the 12th over when Australia were at 98 runs and were cruising but after that, England did well to apply pressure and kept picking up wickets at regular intervals. They lost 4 wickets in no time and this was a total collapse by the visitors. Stoinis played a good cameo but could not pull the team to victory here. Archer and Rashid did well to pick up two wickets each. The bowlers bowled well in the last 10 overs and Morgan will be pleased with the comeback and grit shown by his boys.

There it is! Curran holds his nerve and England hold their nerves! What a comeback from England! They were brilliant at the death. Very full delivery on middle, Stoinis can only flick it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. ENGLAND WIN BY 2 RUNS.
Full delivery on mid-wicket, Stoinis heaves it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple. Are we in for a Super Over?
7 needed from 2! Good length ball on middle, Stoinis looks to heave it to the deep mid-wicket region but gets a top edge. 4 fielders converge but falls short. 2 runs taken.
MISS, SIX, MISS! Full delivery outside off, Stoinis has a big swing at that but fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! What a shot that is! Brilliant! Just at the right time for Australia! Back of a length ball outside off, Stoinis hammers it over the deep cover region for a biggie.
PLAY AND A MISS! Stoinis cannot get anything on the bat! Short ball outside off, Stoinis looks to pull but misses. 15 from 5.

OUT! RUN OUT! Agar has to go as he is out of his crease! Excellent work from Jordan but the question will be why did not Agar dive? The dive would have saved him! Important thing for Australia is that Stoinis will be on strike. Jordan bowls a good length ball on the pads, Stoinis looks to heave it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Stoinis calls Agar for the single and Agar takes off. Jordan runs ahead and hits the stumps with the ball. There is an appeal for run out and the third umpire is called into question. First the review for LBW. The Ball Tracker shows that it is missing the stumps. Coming to the run out, Agar is short and he has to go. 15 needed from the last over.
An appeal for run out taken upstairs. Jordan thinks that he has got him. Let's see what happens. England have taken a review for LBW as well.
SWING AND A MISS! What an over this is turning out to be from Jordan so far! Slower ball outside off, Stoinis looks to cut but misses. 15 from 7. What a match we are having.
Short ball outside off, Agar looks to pull but it takes the inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters pick up a single.
On a length on off, Stoinis pushes it wide of the bowler and calls Agar for the single. 16 more from 9 balls.
Full delivery outside off, Agar pushes it to point and takes the single. The fielder decides not to throw it.
Short ball on middle, Stoinis pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Chris Jordan will bowl the 19th over.
Short of a good length around off, Stoinis pushes this towards the off side and will retain strike for the next over. 19 required off 12 balls now!
Good length outside the off pole, Stoinis punches this towards deep cover for a couple.
On a good length outside off, Agar pushes this to point where Ali does well to stop this one. The batters will take a single.
Good length around off, Stoinis works this to the off side for a single.
Back of a length around off, Agar plays it to the off side and the batters exchange ends.
Back of a length ball around off, Stoinis pushes this to mid off for a single.
Tom Curran is on now. 2-0-14-0, his figures so far.
Back of a length ball on middle, Marcus works it to deep square leg for a single.
A couple now! Full delivery outside off, Stoinis squirts it towards the deep point region and picks up a couple. 27 required from 19 deliveries.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Agar looks to flick but it takes the pads and goes to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Ashton Agar makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! This is a real burst from England! They are right back in it and Australia are making a big mess of this game. They were well on top but their will be a bit of nerves now. Excellent captaincy from Morgan as he is bringing in the wicket-taking bowlers on at the right time. Back of a length ball on the pads, Carey looks to defend but it hits the pads and it goes onto hit the off stump. 30 required from 21 balls.
Another dot! Good length ball outside off, punched to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Carey works it to mid-wicket.
Mark Wood will finish his spell.
Good length outside off, Carey cuts this to the fielder at third man for a single. 30 required off 24 balls now! Who will clinch this?
Good length around middle and leg, Carey plays this towards the leg side.
Full toss on middle, Stoinis digs this out towards mid on for a single.
On a good length outside off, Stoinis looks to cut that but misses it.
WIDE! On a good length around middle and leg, it goes down leg and the batters run through for a bye. Umpire signals wide as well.
Alex Carey is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Can England turn this around? They have done well to pick up all these quick wickets and will now have two new batters at the crease. On a good length around middle and leg, Warner moves to his left and looks to cream this one through the cover region but he misses and Jofra hits the leg stump here and sends Warner back to the hut.
Back of a length around off and middle, Warner pulls this towards the deep square leg area for two runs.
Marcus Stoinis comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's a bad piece of cricket from Glenn Maxwell! Rashid had just one ball left in his spell but Maxwell wants to go big but has hit the ball straight to the fielder. England are not giving up. Floated ball outside off, Maxwell looks to go big over the cover region but he hits it straight to Morgan at cover. Poor cricket but that's how Maxwell plays. 36 needed from 30 balls.
Short and outside off, David punches it to long off for a single.
Maxwell is off the mark! Flatter on middle, Maxwell works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on middle, Warner pulls it to the deep on the leg side for a single.
Glenn Maxwell is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Well taken in the deep and does England still have a chance? Smith falls and Rashid gets a wicket in his final over. Rashid tosses this on middle, Smith looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes towards deep square leg. Bairstow runs across from deep mid-wicket and takes a good catch. 39 more required from 34 balls.
Lovely from Rashid! Floated outside off, Smith looks to flick but misses.
Short ball around off, Warner comes down the track and plays this to the off side but can only find the fielder there. 39 required now in 36 balls!
Tossed up around off, Warner plays this to the fielder at cover.
Tossed up around middle, Smith plays this towards the fielder at long on for a single.

SIX! Steve Smith has joined the party! What a stroke by Steve! Does it even look like these Australian batters have not played for over six months? Loopy around off, Smith dances down the track and smacks this one over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Victory edging towards the visitors!
Floated around off, Warner reverse sweeps this to the fielder at short third man for a quick single.
Flatter around middle and leg, Smith tucks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Moeen Ali comes onto bowl.
Flighted on off, Warner plays it to point.
Low full toss on middle, Warner flicks it to deep mid-wicket for an easy couple.
Flatter on middle, Smith tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Smith dances down the track and then looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to the off side. No runs.
Tossed up outside off, Smith taps it to the slip fielder.
Short and outside off, Warner punches it to deep cover for a single.

FIFTY FOR WARNER! His 18th T20I Fifty for the left handed Aussie and what a knock this has been so far but he will want to pull his team through the finish line! Short ball around middle and leg, Warner nudges this behind square to retain the strike for the next over.
Short ball around middle and leg, Warner pulls this to the deep mid-wicket area for a couple. Brilliant running by the batters here again as they converted this single into a double.
Back of a good length around middle and leg, Smith pushes this to the off side and they will take a quick single.

FOUR! A mis-field and Smith will get two boundaries in two balls. On a short length around off, Smith pulls this hard towards the mid-wicket region and Banton makes a mess of it and Australia will get four more runs.
FOUR! Steve Smith is off the mark here with a stylish shot! On a short length around off and middle, Steve pulls this hard through the deep square leg area for four runs.
Short ball around leg, Warner tucks this to the fielder at deep fine leg for one run.
Steven Smith comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! There's the wicket that England needed! Finch looked to go over mid off but fails to time it well. End of a good innings from Aaron Finch and end of a brilliant partnership. Archer bowls a good length ball on off, Finch looks to go over mid off but does not get the required elevation. It goes straight to Jordan at mid off, who makes no mistake. 65 more needed from 54 balls.
Back of a length ball on middle, David works it to deep square leg for a single.
Just short of Wood! Short ball around the middle and leg stump line, Finch hooks it to fine leg. Wood runs ahead and attempts to catch but it falls short. Just a single.
Slower ball outside off, Finch cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Fullish on middle, Warner heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Warner looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
Short ball on middle, Finch swats it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Jofra Archer is back on. 2-0-20-0 are his figures so far.

Back of a good length outside off, Warner looks to gently tap this into the off side but he doesn't make contact. Great over for the hosts here. Need some more of these! Need 72 off the last 10 overs here.
On a short length outside off, Finch cuts this to the fielder at point and the batsmen take a quick single.
WIDE! Short of a good length around middle and leg, Finch leaves it as it is down leg. The umpire signals wide.
A short ball around off, Finch plays this to point on the hop.
Bouncer! This is a bouncer on top of middle, Finch ducks under this one.
A short one on the body, Warner pulls this on the up toward mid-wicket for a single.
A back of a good length ball around middle, Warner looks to pull but misses as it hits him right on his gut.
WIDE! The umpire signals wide as this short ball was around leg.
Mark Wood is back into the attack. His first over cost 11 runs.
Outside off, cut to point. 17 from Rashid's over. 76 needed from 11 overs.
FOUR! Finch is a good player of spin and that is on show here! Floated outside off, Finch plays the inside out drive over the extra cover fielder and into the fence.
FOUR! This is excellent batting from Finch! He has started to get the better of Rashid! Full delivery outside off, Finch drives it to deep cover region for a boundary.
SIX! That has gone a mile! That's the power of Aaron Finch! These two have not shown any rustiness so far! Loopy on middle, Finch powers it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Loopy ball on middle, Warner plays it to long on for a single.
A couple now! Loopy ball on middle, Warner plays the reverse sweep. It takes the top edge and goes to deep square leg. Before the fielder can clean it up, the batters take two.
Good length outside off, Warner plays this to the off side for one more run to end the over.
Another slower one around middle and leg, Finch tucks this to mid-wicket for a single.
A slower short ball outside off, Warner cuts this between the fielders at backward point and short third man for three runs as the fielder does well to stop this before it crosses the fence.
WIDE! The umpire signals wide as this full ball is way outside off.
Back of a good length ball around leg, Warner flicks this to deep square leg and the batters come back for the second run. Great running by the batsmen here!
Good length outside off, Warner looks to drive but misses this.
Good length outside off, Warner punches this hard to deep cover region for a couple.

NOT OUT! Finch was in! Good over though from Rashid! Looped up ball outside off, Finch looks to defend but gets beaten. Buttler collects and whips the bails off. He is confident that Finch has been stumped and appeals. The on-field umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Finch was in. Brilliant bowling from Rashid though.
An appeal for stumping taken upstairs. Buttler seems confident. Let's see what happens.
Excellent running between the wickets! Tossed up on middle, Finch drives it wide of long off for another couple.
PLAY AND A MISS! Well bowled! Short ball outside off, Finch looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Short ball outside off, Warner pulls it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Warner sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
BEATEN! Beautiful start from Rashid! Loopy ball outside off, Warner looks to drive but misses.
Adil Rashid is on now.
Good length on off, Finch fends this out. Australia are at 55/0 at the end of the PowerPlay and they are looking good with the bat!

On a good length outside off, Finch plays this on the up over the cover region but it doesn't have enough to reach the rope. Eoin Morgan does well to stop it at the deep and the batters will get a couple.
Good length around the off stump, Warner pushes this to the off side for one run.
On a good length around leg, Warner tucks this to the deep square leg area for a couple.
Leg Bye! Good length around leg, Finch looks to flick but misses and the ball rolls away to the square leg. The batters will take one run. 50-run stand up for the visitors with this run!

FOUR! Australia haven't played since March 2020 but there is no sign of rustiness with their batting so far! On a good length around off, Finch lifts this over the fielder at mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
Good length ball outside off, pushed to point. Good start from Curran.
Aaron Finch has called for a change of bat.
Back of a length ball on the pads, Warner works it to short fine leg for a single.
Slower one outside off, Finch dances down the track and then punches it to mid on. A single taken.
Short ball on middle, Finch blocks it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on middle, David works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Warner looks to heave it away but fails to make any connection with it.
Tom Curran is into the attack.

FOUR! Classic shot by Finch here and Australia are off to a flyer of a start. On a good length outside off, Finch goes on his back foot and punches this through the backward point region past the boundary ropes for four more.
WIDE! A back of a length ball around middle and leg, goes down leg as Finch looks to pull. Umpire signals for a wide.
On a good length around off, Finch looks to punch this on his back foot through backward point but it comes off his inside edge and the keeper collects this one.
A slow full toss outside off, Warner pushes this to the off side for one run.
On a good length around middle, Warner looks to flick but gets hit on the pads instead. The players appeal but the umpire does not flinch.
FOUR! Great batting by the openers of Australia! On a good length outside off, Warner cuts this fine over the point region and it bounces and crosses the fence at backward point.
Short of a good length outside off, Warner looks to play at that but misses it and looks surprised that is is not called a wide.
Chris Jordan is coming into bowl.
Good length ball on the pads, Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Shovelled! Clever batting from Finch! Short ball on the pads, Finch tickles it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, Warner guides it to third man for a single.
Good length ball on the pads, Warner flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region and picks up a couple.
FOUR! Pulled away in disdain! England have started really poorly! Short on middle, Warner pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Very full delivery on middle, Warner plays it back to the bowler.
On a good length outside off, Finch punches this straight to the fielder at point. A good over for the Australians!
Good length around middle, Warner plays this through the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Another one! 4 boundaries already for the visitors here! Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Warner pulls this one fine towards the fence at deep fine leg and will get four runs for his effort.
Short ball around off, Warner punches this to the fielder at mid off.
Back of a good length outside off, Warner dabs this one on the up over the mid off fielder and will get a couple.

FOUR! Short of a good length outside off, Warner looks to play it through the off side but it comes off an inside edge and goes past the Jofra at short fine leg into the fence at deep fine leg. A good start by the visitors!
Mark Wood will bowl from the other end.
Slower delivery on middle, and leg, Finch looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and rolls to point. 9 from the first over.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Archer! That is exactly what England did not want as the fine leg fielder had just come up! Full delivery on the pads, Finch flicks it to the fine leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away and pulled nicely! First boundary of the innings! Short ball on middle, Finch pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery from Archer! He is cranking up some pace here! Good length ball outside off, Finch looks to drive but misses it completely.
Back of a length ball outside off, Finch rocks on his back foot and then pushes it to point.
Australia are underway! Short ball outside off, Warner punches it to cover and takes a single.
We are back for the chase! The England players make their way out to the middle, followed by Aaron Finch and David Warner. Jofra Archer will start with the ball.
